fresh_graphql.title: 30001223: accept Young-module counterexamples in odd characteristic
fresh_graphql.body:
Accepts a complete negative answer to both broad bridges in Miyachi's printed2009 Conjecture7. For every odd prime p over an algebraically closed characteristic-p field at q=1, degree r=2p-1 and lambda=(2p-2,1), the source-convention Young module is simple, whereas its polynomial injective I_n(lambda) is nonprojective for every permitted rank n>=2. The stronger index-set proposal is refuted without treating it as an established equivalence. The separate DeVisscher-Donkin classification and characteristic-zero nontrivial-root variants are outside this result.

[Simple Young modules with nonprojective polynomial injective hulls](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23418581), Alec Kriebel, ORCID0009-0001-9320-500X, version1.0,16October2026. The four-page research note and exact source/verification archive are published; DOI resolves and both public downloads match the reviewed SHA256/size. Tracker entry 'Math Puzzles'!A126:D126 was appended through Google Workspace CLI and read back exactly.

The natural Young/augmentation calculation, local GL2 facts and DD/Cox-Parker/Erdmann-Law structural inputs are classical and credited. The explicit stable-FI labelling and every-rank dominance/labelled-truncation deduction are included in full. Priority remains UNRESOLVED: extensive bounded source audits verified no complete predecessor in inspected statements, but unread EH2002a/b, Fang2014, Fang-JunHu2025online/2026issue, old tables/books and citation/version gaps remain material. No firstness, certified novelty or current worldwide-open-status claim is made.

Validation includes two independently positioned mathematical families, two priority families with later peer challenge, and two distinct whole-preprint reviewers, both reporting zero actionable issues on identical frozen213-file source/six release outputs. Existing reviewer sessions were reused after fresh initialization failed ENOSPC; prior exposure and independence limits are disclosed. Core and supported NumPy/external-body checks, actual normal/optimized replays, deterministic rebuilds, all four actual PDF pages, tamper/nonregular controls and independently verified review custody passed. Finite computations support the written universal proof; they are not proof-assistant certification.

All41 original candidate files/three ZIPs are retained unchanged. Original reviewed candidate head:34f21454986a28ca49f24999be3a0fd1b42755f8. Its QUEUE status was exactly claimed_solved1/5; no new substantive proof-attempt turn was used. A separately adversarially audited case-only production adapter handles Zenodo's one observed HTML encoding n>=2 to n>=2, with identical displayed text; all supplied metadata otherwise match, shared tool and six reviewed files remain unchanged, and only one known draft/publication was used.

AI tools were used extensively in development, literature investigation, computation, drafting, reproduction and adversarial review. This is an unrefereed preprint without external human peer review or formal proof verification. [Final readiness, sealed reviews and publication/tracker receipts](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/tree/main/draft_pr_claimed_solved_700_800_20261012/audits/pr786_30001223/tmp).
